title: Sources: Google is in talks with Samsung to manufacture a memory input-output die for its 10th-gen Icefish TPU, while making the computing engine at TSMC (Qianer Liu/The Information)
summary: Qianer Liu / The Information: Sources: Google is in talks with Samsung to manufacture a memory input-output die for its 10th-gen Icefish TPU, while making the computing engine at TSMC — Google is considering giving Samsung Electronics a crucial role in making a component of one of its most advanced future AI chips …
